snippet.title: Mini Words - Xbox trailer
snippet.description:
721 words. That is enough to cover 90% of conversations in English. Unscramble those words in Mini Words - a unique mix of puzzle, word search and hangman.
Developed by Mens Sana Interactive
Xbox release: 27/Aug/202
